title: Site in Texas that teaches blindfolded sensing
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Site in Texas that teaches blindfolded sensing, about an unknown time at Texas (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's I think a site in Texas that teaches people to kind of develop these senses

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he thinks there is a site in Texas that teaches people to develop unusual senses, such as sensing things while blindfolded. He mentions it in a conversation about the edges of science, as a hint that people may have abilities that can be trained.
